title: Know The Law | Which Documents Require Mandatory Proof Of Attestation? Supreme Court Explains
description: In an important ruling clarifying the scope of Section 68 of the Indian Evidence Act, the Supreme Court has explained that the statutory requirement of proving a document by examining an attesting witness applies only to documents that are required by law to be attested. A registered sale deed, the Court held, does not fall within this category and therefore need not be proved in the manner contemplated under Section 68. The ruling came from a Bench of Justice JB Pardiwala and Justice Manoj Misr
